headline: Linn Mercy Leads Base Surge; DeadLands, Marban Hollow Active
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Linn Mercy has seized the pacesetter's role, recording seventeen strategic-base actions in two hours and twenty-three in a day. Marban Hollow, the last report's lone active front, remains hot with four fresh actions. DeadLands, quiet on the flips board when last filed, has resumed with two new base events while casualties mount past seven thousand Colonials and nearly nine thousand Wardens in two hours. Endless Shore and Farranac Coast both show fresh actions; Oarbreaker has seen five in two hours. Stema Landing, silent in the previous dispatch, has joined the roll. Fishermans Row and Drowned Vale, once busy, have cooled. Weathered Expanse still bleeds heavily—some fourteen thousand casualties on each side in a day—yet records no base actions. The front is wide and shifting, and no final decision is yet reported.
